exposure: Group C2: 1% preservative-free 2-CP 3 ml (30 mg) + 0.5 ml fentanyl (25 mug)
Group C1: 1% preservative-free 2-CP 3 ml (30 mg) + 0.5 ml normal saline
cohort: 120 healthy, term parturients planned for elective lower segment Cesarean section (LSCS)
finding: The addition of fentanyl to 1% 2-chloroprocaine intrathecally prolonged the duration of sensory block and postoperative analgesia in patients undergoing LSCS.
